short: Queen consort to Henry VI and a principal leader of the Lancastrian cause during the Wars of the Roses.
full:
Born on 23 March 1430, Margaret of Anjou married King Henry VI of England in a diplomatic union intended to secure peace with France. As Henry suffered from bouts of severe mental illness, Margaret emerged as a resolute political force, fiercely defending the succession rights of her son, Edward of Westminster.

She built a powerful faction to oppose Richard of York, effectively leading the Lancastrian war effort. Following the disastrous defeat at Tewkesbury in 1471 and the death of her son, she was taken prisoner by Edward IV. She was eventually ransomed to France, where she died in 1482.
